function.name: settle
function.return: list of [sender,recipient,integer_cents] or object with transfers plus optional reported_net

remainder: Any integer equal split allocating each remainder cent to a beneficiary is acceptable; total cents must be conserved. Historical programs retain their documented SHA-bound remainder policy.
optimality: Minimize positive transfers among all valid transfers realizing the selected legal net balances; no preferred route.

automatic_detection.function: Unique undecorated, unshadowed top-level def settle(people, expenses), determined only by AST before one execution.
automatic_detection.stdin_json: A module docstring line TokenClock H01 interface: stdin_json/v1.
automatic_detection.ambiguity: Multiple definitions, shadowed functions or both interface declarations remain unmapped; never execute alternatives to select a winning score.

public_ledger.input: Unique undecorated local Ledger; constructor defaults or people; add/add_expense parameter roles payer,amount,beneficiaries with local major-currency-to-cent conversion evidence. No optimizer options are changed.
public_ledger.output: Declared list[Transfer] fields from_/to/cents or payer/payee/cents; or explicitly cent-denominated triples; major-currency triples need explicit local conversion syntax. Optional balance units are read independently.
public_ledger.scope: Declarations are an interface interpretation, not a proof of semantic correctness. Exact source/program hashes and original AST spans are saved. Unmapped declarations remain unknown.
public_ledger.execution: One chosen adapter runs only inside verified OS sandbox. No candidate code rewriting or alternative entry/unit score selection.

automatic_detection.python_blocks: A unique block containing definitions may be selected when all other parseable blocks refer to its declared names and do not declare/read another stdin interface. Other cases remain ambiguous; ignored examples are never executed.
